sentences.en: At our high school, French is an elective.
sentences.zh: 在我们高中，法语是一门选修课。

sentences.en: It is better in schools to have several language electives available to students.
sentences.zh: 在学校里为学生提供几种语言的选修课程更好。

sentences.en: In schools in Hispanic countries, English is just an elective subject that few take.
sentences.zh: 在讲西班牙语的国家的学校里，英语仅仅是一门很少人选择的选修科目。
